name: MEGA RAMP FOR SLIME
desc:
Drive down the mega ramp with your car and try to jump as far as possible.

When you land in the Landing Zone, open the mystery box to discover new slimes.

Place your slimes in your base to earn money every second.

Upgrade your slimes, buy better cars, jump farther, and find rarer slimes.

Complete your Slime Index and become the richest player!
